description: The file defines the ReportsProvider class, which manages fetching and caching report data such as totals, breakdowns, and trend series for a Flutter expense tracking app. It interacts with a ReportRepository to load data for specific date ranges and exposes methods to retrieve cached results and error states.

classes.name: ReportsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages report data fetching and caching for the UI, providing totals, breakdowns, and trend data for a specified date range.

methods.name: loadOverview
methods.description: Fetches totals and category breakdowns for a specified date range and caches the results.

methods.name: loadTrends
methods.description: Fetches weekly trend and monthly summary series for a specified date range and caches the results.
